description: Watch for a failed deployment or for monthly AI spend to reach a threshold. AI spend is sampled on the five-minute sweep. An active alarm fires on the first sampled value at or above its threshold, then rearms after a lower reading or a new UTC month. Owners and admins choose whether occurrences should also appear in the inbox and go to the workspace's subscribed webhook endpoints. Every occurrence is available through read_alarm_occurrences. A compatible MCP client can subscribe to the returned resource address. Use the same request id on a retry.

destinations.description: Choose each additional delivery destination explicitly. Both may be false.

request_id.description: A fresh UUID for this alarm; reuse on a retry.

project_id.description: One project in this workspace. Omit to watch the whole workspace.

threshold_cents.description: The AI spend threshold for a UTC calendar month, in whole USD cents. Reaching it sends an alert and does not change a spending limit.

workspace_id.description: Workspace id from whoami; omit when there is one.

name: create_alarm
title: Create a workspace alarm
